numericCases.description: Close above its 20-period SMA with engine-identical warm-up.
Close[0] > High[1] and Close[1] < High[2] using completed-bar bracket lookback.
ref(close, 3) folds into an equivalent field lookback.
Crossover across equal values must follow previous<=previous and current>current.
Crossunder across equal values must follow previous>=previous and current<current.
ATR(14) above 2% of close (scanner-only ATR semantics).
Nested arithmetic with division and multiplication.
A series divided by a zero series yields null, never Infinity.
Logical operators propagate nulls without fabricating matches.
Equality comparison on a derived series.
Zero-volume bars with volumeSma warm-up and multiplication.

compileCases.description: Pattern calls are accepted only when pattern rules are allowed.
Chart-pattern function shorthand compiles to the four accepted ids.
Numeric expressions cannot smuggle in a pattern call.
Unknown functions are rejected at compile time.
Unsupported chart patterns never silently disappear.
Shifting a computed series is not expressible in AST v1.
Scanner rules are single boolean conditions, not multi-line assignments.
Bracket lookback is limited to OHLCV fields.
Structural errors are reported, never ignored.

contractCases.description: activeNseEq is an explicit, narrow universe with no target list.
Adjusted basis may opt into dividend/rights adjustments.
Raw basis plus adjustment flags is contradictory.
Unknown transport fields are rejected, not ignored.
Only the four parity-proven gap patterns are native rules.
Negative lookbacks are rejected before any scan work.
Duplicate explicit targets are rejected instead of scanned twice.
Schema versions are versioned and enforced.
Rule ids must be unique per run.
